karty.priklad: Mae'r plant yn cael addysg gorfforol bob dydd Llun.
karty.priklad_cs: The children have PE every Monday (corfforol → [g]orfforol after the feminine addysg; pob → [b]ob as an adverbial).
karty.mnemo: corff (body) → corfforol (physical): after PE your face is as red as tomato soup.

extra.pozn: in the Geirfa in the box arall; as a noun it's feminine like addysg, hence the soft mutation of the adjective; corfforol = physical (L13); own example

karty.priklad: Amser maith yn ôl, roedd castell ar y bryn 'ma.
karty.priklad_cs: A long time ago there was a castle on this hill.

extra.pozn: maith = long (of time), more literary; ers amser maith = for a long time; own example

karty.cs: to enjoy, to get a taste for
karty.priklad: Gobeithio byddwch chi'n cael blas arnyn nhw!
karty.mnemo: blas = taste: to get a taste for something.

extra.pozn: in the Geirfa in the box arall; cael is irregular (ces i flas ar…, cafodd hi flas ar…); soft mutation after ar (cael blas ar fwyd); ar with endings: arna i, arnat ti, arno fe, arni hi, arnon ni, arnoch chi, arnyn nhw; literal (Roedd hi'n cael blas ar ei brecwast, p. 153) and figurative = to get a taste for something; sentence from the dialogue on p. 153

karty.priklad: Ces i hyd i bwrs ar y stryd.
karty.priklad_cs: I found a purse in the street (pwrs → [b]wrs after i).
karty.mnemo: hyd = length: you go the whole length of it until you find it.

extra.pozn: in the Geirfa in the box arall; cael is irregular (ces i hyd i…, cawson nhw hyd i…); synonym dod o hyd i (L8); soft mutation after i; own example

sever.priklad: Ges i hyd i bwrs ar y stryd.
sever.priklad_cs: I found a purse in the street (pwrs → [b]wrs after i).
sever.pozn: north: ges i instead of ces i (outside the coursebook)

karty.priklad: Jac yw'r canfed babi i gael ei eni yn yr ysbyty.
karty.priklad_cs: Jac is the hundredth baby to be born in the hospital (geni → [e]ni after ei = his).

extra.pozn: goes before the noun; a feminine noun mutates after y: y ganfed flwyddyn; ordinal numbers in detail in L17; sentence from the papur bro, p. 149

sever.priklad: Jac ydy'r canfed babi i gael ei eni yn yr ysbyty.
sever.priklad_cs: Jac is the hundredth baby to be born in the hospital.
sever.pozn: north: ydy instead of yw (derived from L5 Beth yw / Be ydy)

karty.priklad: Mae hi wedi gwella ar ôl cael triniaeth am ganser y fron.
karty.priklad_cs: She's recovered after treatment for breast cancer (canser → [g]anser after am).
karty.mnemo: canser (cancer) + y fron (of the breast; bron → fron after y, feminine).

extra.pozn: in the Geirfa in the box arall; as a noun masculine like canser; bron → fron after y (bron is feminine); in the book: ymchwil i driniaethau canser y fron (p. 149); own example

karty.priklad_cs: Last night's game was a draw (cyfartal → [g]yfartal after the feminine gêm).
karty.mnemo: Two teams split one ruby-red trophy in half.

extra.pozn: in the Geirfa in the box arall; as a noun feminine like gêm, hence gyfartal; plural gemau cyfartal (no mutation in the plural); own example

karty.priklad: Roedd y syniad yn ffitio i'r dim.
karty.mnemo: Literally "to the nothing": not a scrap left over, it fits completely.

extra.pozn: also on its own as an exclamation I'r dim! = Exactly! (L15, no card there); sentence from the text about Nansi Richards, p. 153

karty.priklad: O hyn ymlaen, bydda i'n siarad Cymraeg gartre.
karty.priklad_cs: From now on I'll speak Welsh at home.
karty.mnemo: o (from) + hyn (this) + ymlaen (forward): from this point forward.

sever.priklad: O hyn ymlaen, bydda i'n siarad Cymraeg adra.
sever.priklad_cs: From now on I'll speak Welsh at home.
sever.pozn: north: adra instead of gartre (outside the coursebook)

karty.priklad: Gwnes i TGAU Cymraeg yn yr ysgol.
karty.priklad_cs: I did Welsh GCSE at school.
karty.mnemo: Tystysgrif Gyffredinol Addysg Uwchradd = General Certificate of Secondary Education.

extra.pozn: Tystysgrif Gyffredinol Addysg Uwchradd; said letter by letter; the book gives no gender; own example

karty.priklad: Mae hi'n siarad Ffrangeg yn ogystal â Chymraeg.
karty.priklad_cs: She speaks French as well as Welsh (Cymraeg → [Ch]ymraeg after â).
karty.mnemo: cystal = as good: yn ogystal â = as well as.

extra.pozn: before a vowel ag (yn ogystal ag Almaeneg); own example

karty.priklad: Roedd hi dan deimlad wrth siarad am ei thad-cu.
karty.priklad_cs: She was emotional talking about her grandfather (tad-cu → [th]ad-cu after ei = her).
karty.mnemo: dan (under) + teimlad (feeling): under the sway of your feelings.

extra.pozn: teimlad → deimlad after dan; teimlad = feeling (L8); phrase from Robin Radio (p. 158), own sentence

sever.priklad: Roedd hi dan deimlad wrth siarad am ei thaid.
sever.priklad_cs: She was emotional talking about her grandfather (taid → [th]aid after ei = her).

karty.cs: for the time being, for now
karty.mnemo: am (for) + y tro (this turn): for this time.

extra.pozn: dros dro = temporarily (L1); phrase from Robin Radio (p. 158), own sentence
